description: This file defines the RequestFormatRouteFilter class, which implements route filtering based on request format in Drupal. It handles selecting routes matching the request's format, determining default formats, and generating appropriate HTTP responses when no match is found.

classes.name: RequestFormatRouteFilter
classes.description: A route filter class that filters routes based on the request format, used within Drupal's routing system.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters the route collection based on the request format, returning matching routes or throwing an exception if none match.

methods.name: getDefaultFormat
methods.description: Determines the default request format based on the route collection.

methods.name: getAvailableFormats
methods.description: Retrieves all available request formats from the route collection.
